verdicts.reason: A rearranges the design into a real banner, photo left and a large readable headline right. But the cloud shapes are now faint grey outlines floating on white, stray sparkles drift around, the photo sits flush against the left edge with uneven top and bottom margins, and a sparkle cross collides with the hands. B is just the original shrunk into a centre column with large dead white areas on both sides, and 'EVERYONE IS WELCOME!' is tiny and barely legible, so it ignores the banner format.
